archetypes.name: issue-interop
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes the contract between Step 18a stall recovery and /larch:issue batch input/output handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the new Step 18a first-detection flow correctly composes the headed issue input file, captures /larch:issue stdout, and normalizes create and dedup outputs into the env file later consumed by terminal-failure comments. Pay particular attention to dry-run, consumer or forked repo routing, failed item handling, stale env removal, and whether the documented prose is executable enough for the orchestrator to follow safely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-kv
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds Bash parsing, filtering, temp-file, and atomic-write logic around untrusted key/value stdout.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new normalize-issue-env implementation and safe_step_value tightening for Bash correctness under set -euo pipefail. Check key filtering, numeric and URL validation, duplicate fallback precedence, temp-file cleanup, atomic write failure behavior, stale output removal, and compatibility with existing kv_get/read-session-env-key conventions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
